name: Curfew bells
body: By order of the watch: the gates close at the second bell after dusk. Those found outside the walls after that hour sleep outside them, or in the cells.

name: Cellar vermin
body: Rats in the cellar of a respectable house. Too many, too bold, and they come from somewhere. Pay on proof of work.

name: Lost: brass-bound ledger
body: Lost on a coach bench: a brass-bound ledger, no great value to anyone but its owner. No questions asked.

name: Bounty: the thing in the north fields
body: Livestock lost on three farms. Bring proof of the kill, or at least a good description.

name: Wanted: man with a missing finger
body: Information sought on a man missing the ring finger of his left hand, last seen leaving the market in a hurry. Do not approach him.

name: Hands wanted: caravan guards
body: Guards wanted for a caravan leaving in a few days. Experience preferred, discretion required. Ask what's in the wagons, and you're not hired.

name: Bounty: road bandits
body: The road's been cut for a month. These bandits are organised and well informed. Bring back their leader, or the people feeding them news.

name: Wanted: a poisoner
body: A woman who sold bad medicine to the wrong people. Keeps to the back streets and has a different name for each lodging. Alive, if you can.

name: Seeking a travelling companion
body: Traveller bound for a far town seeks a companion with a good sword and better manners. I pay for meals. I also snore.

name: Closed for a private gathering
body: The back room is closed on the next market night for a private gathering. Do not ask. Do not listen at the door.

name: Alms day
body: Alms are given at the shrine at midday on the last day of the week. The faithful are asked to bring bread, blankets, or coin, and the others to bring patience.

name: Escort for a pilgrim
body: An elderly pilgrim must reach a distant shrine before the season turns. Safe passage, not speed. The pilgrim is stubborn and will not be carried.

name: Prayers for the missing
body: My brother left for the hills before the thaw and has not written. If you've seen him, or his mule, tell me. If you've seen only the mule, tell me that too.

name: A discreet courier
body: A sealed package must reach its recipient in the next town by the end of the week. You may not open it, and you may not lose it. Apply in person, alone.

name: New toll on the market road
body: From the new moon, a toll is due at the market road for every cart and animal. Those who can't pay may leave their goods in the care of the watch.
